tools.name: channeldock_check_auth
tools.description: Check that the configured ChannelDock API key pair is valid. Returns the API's confirmation message. Calls GET /api/v2/.

tools.name: channeldock_list_orders
tools.description: List the seller's orders with order lines, status, totals, and channel. Filter by sales channel, status, or last-updated window. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/orders.

tools.name: channeldock_search_order
tools.description: Find one order by its order number: the ChannelDock order id, the channel's remote order id, or the sequence order id. Calls POST /api/v2/seller/searchorder.

tools.name: channeldock_list_order_logs
tools.description: Read the activity log of one order: status changes, label events, and manual notes. Use the internal ChannelDock order id, not the channel order number. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/orderlogs.

tools.name: channeldock_list_inventory
tools.description: List the seller's main products with stock levels, EAN, SKU, prices, and dimensions. Look up by EAN or SKU, or pass up to 50 values in eans or skus (comma-separated). Calls GET /api/v2/seller/inventory.

tools.name: channeldock_list_listings
tools.description: List the seller's marketplace listings: title, description, price, category, and publish state per sales channel. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/listings.

tools.name: channeldock_list_bundles
tools.description: List bundle products (a parent product with child products and quantities). Filter by product id, EAN, or SKU of the parent. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/bundles.

tools.name: channeldock_list_product_tags
tools.description: List the seller's product tags with their colors. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/product-tags.

tools.name: channeldock_list_variant_groups
tools.description: List variant groups (products that are variants of one family), or the group of one product. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/variant-groups.

tools.name: channeldock_list_stock_locations
tools.description: List the stock locations (where stock sits on which shelf) of the seller's own warehouse. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/stocklocations.

tools.name: channeldock_list_stock_sections
tools.description: List stock sections (physical shelves or locations) of the seller's warehouse. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/stocksections.

tools.name: channeldock_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the seller's warehouses with their priority and whether they accept orders. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/warehouses.

tools.name: channeldock_list_channels
tools.description: List the seller's connected integrations: sales channels, fulfillment, and carriers, with status. Credentials are not returned. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/channels.

tools.name: channeldock_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments (shipping labels) with their carrier, tracking reference, status, and order lines. Labels are not included. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/shipment.

tools.name: channeldock_list_returns
tools.description: List customer returns with their order, handling status, and comments. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/returns.

tools.name: channeldock_list_carriers
tools.description: List the carrier codes and carrier names that ChannelDock knows, for example postnl = PostNL. This is a catalog, not the seller's own shipping setup. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/carriers.

tools.name: channeldock_list_deliveries
tools.description: List pending inbound deliveries (purchase orders from suppliers) and outbound replenishment deliveries, with dates and batch or expiry data. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/delivery.

tools.name: channeldock_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with contact details, payment terms, and VAT number. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/suppliers.

tools.name: channeldock_list_tasks
tools.description: List the seller's internal tasks (for example, a stock count or a follow-up), with status and planned time. Returns all statuses unless status is set. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/tasks.

tools.name: channeldock_update_product
tools.description: Update one product's stock (corrected_stock), price, title, EAN, or product reference. Identify the product by product_id. Other fields stay unchanged. Overwrites the given values. Calls PUT /api/v2/seller/inventory.

tools.name: channeldock_add_order_log
tools.description: Add a note to an order's activity log (for example, 'picked in warehouse A'). It adds an entry and changes no order data. Calls POST /api/v2/seller/orderlogs.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "channeldock_list_channels" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the seller's connected integrations: sales channels, fulfillment, and carriers, with status. Credentials are not returned. Calls GET /api/v2/seller/channel…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: channeldock_check_auth, channeldock_search_order, channeldock_list_returns · Private data: channeldock_check_auth, channeldock_list_channels, channeldock_list_suppliers · Public sink: channeldock_search_order, channeldock_list_listings, channeldock_add_order_log.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: channeldock_check_auth, channeldock_search_order, channeldock_list_returns · Private data: channeldock_check_auth, channeldock_list_channels, channeldock_list_suppliers · Public sink: channeldock_search_order, channeldock_list_listings, channeldock_add_order_log

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
